rationale: C19 is a strong reusable template for the child: both are letters tied specifically to Brotherhood Week and develop the same distinctive argument from human dignity and equal freedom, through a contrast with totalitarian slavery, to an appeal for American unity that preserves differences. The child substantially condenses and adapts that sequence. C01 and C22 share some language about peace, human dignity, individual opportunity, and an America worthy of its heritage, but neither matches the occasion or the full argumentative structure nearly as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The ardent belief of our Founding Fathers in human dignity and freedom
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Respect for human dignity is the central issue in the world struggle today. America is dedicated to the conviction that all people are entitled by the gift of God to equal rights and freedoms
shared_material.explanation: Both make human dignity and freedom the foundational American principle for the Brotherhood Week message.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a people at peace, humble before their Creator, tolerant of differences, deriving from their very diversity strength to advance the common good
shared_material.parent_excerpt: our people... must demonstrate a greater measure of fraternity and unity than ever before... stand united, without a state imposed uniformity, for the achievement of that peace and freedom
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts the distinctive idea that unity and peace arise without erasing differences.

shared_material.child_excerpt: proud of the answer thereby given to those who would bind people together in slavery
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Millions of people in our world are living in slavery. They are subject to the iron rule of despots... Free people everywhere are horrified
shared_material.explanation: Both contrast American brotherhood and freedom with coercive slavery abroad.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Through such efforts as yours this progress will continue
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that all citizens will join with you... and with the National Conference of Christians and Jews to help make justice, amity and understanding the daily practice of our nation
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by crediting or urging the recipient's organized efforts to advance brotherhood nationally.
